evals.prompt: Create an implementation plan to add rate limiting to billing-api. Use the spec in spec/spec-process-rate-limiting.md. Target Redis for counters and add a middleware in src/middleware/.
evals.expected_output: A new file plan/feature-rate-limiting-1.md following the mandatory template, with phases, task tables, and a status badge.
expectations: A file is created under plan/ whose name matches <purpose>-<component>-<version>.md with purpose equal to feature
The file has YAML front matter with goal, date_created, and status, and the introduction contains an img.shields.io status badge
Section 2 has at least two 'Implementation Phase N' headings, each with a GOAL-NNN line and a task table with columns Task, Description, Completed, Date
Each TASK-NNN row names a concrete file path such as src/middleware/
The agent runs the duplicate identifier shell checks (grep, sort, uniq -d) against the plan file before finishing

evals.expected_output: The agent asks what the plan is for, or states a one-line assumption, before writing a plan file.
expectations: No file is written under plan/ before the plan purpose is known or explicitly assumed
The transcript asks the user for the plan purpose or states the assumed purpose in one sentence
If a file is written, its name uses one of the purpose prefixes upgrade, refactor, feature, data, infrastructure, process, architecture, or design

evals.prompt: Plan the upgrade of web-app from Node 18 to Node 22. There are 40 services; the plan must let several agents work in parallel without stepping on each other.
evals.expected_output: A new file plan/upgrade-node-runtime-1.md whose phases are independent and whose task identifiers are each declared once.
expectations: A file is created under plan/ with a name starting with upgrade-
Phases declare any cross-phase dependency explicitly or state that none exist
No TASK-NNN or GOAL-NNN identifier is declared in more than one table row
Every phase title is short enough to serve as a GitHub issue title (under 80 characters)
Section 7 lists at least one RISK-NNN and one ASSUMPTION-NNN entry
